high_level_description: stc brand style, a cinematic living room scene of three men on a couch from a television production.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A cozy living room with a gray wall featuring a circular pattern, a framed motorcycle artwork, and a shelf displaying model cars, warm indoor lighting, TV screen visible at the bottom of the frame.

elements.desc: A man in a pink t-shirt and light-colored pants, standing up on the left.
A man in a white sweater, sitting hunched over in the middle.
A man wearing a red and white plaid shirt, green pants, and suspenders, seated on the right.
A small glass bowl of snacks on the couch in front of them.
